what: Acknowledgements for the 23 Oct Phase 3 runs, the 10 Nov finale P3 runs (Qwen2.5-0.5B and 1.5B) and the P3 hardening check after the finale P4 changes. Two kinds: 'affects': false with a reason (E1, E3: the changed code does not run in them), and 'affects': true with 'superseded_by' (E2, E4, E5, the hardening check): accepted by evaluation/check_claims.py only while that directory holds a re-measurement of the experiment whose recorded sources equal the current files. The acknowledged state is the final P4 code (commit change_commit, after the real-model timing default); E2, E4 and E5 were re-measured on it in evidence/finale_p4_2026-11-11/llm_final. The first pass on e048ad9 (evidence/finale_p4_2026-11-11/llm) is kept as recorded and superseded.

changes.reason: finale P4: CreateReq timing_deadline_ms / shadow_model_on_refusal (task 1); signed, expiring, run-scoped capability tokens accepted on run endpoints, POST /api/runs/{id}/capabilities (SHOULD 6).

E1_canary_matrix.why: E1 and E3 call the model adapter directly (llm_common / aegis.model_client over TCP to a llama-server host process that llm_isolation starts itself); no code in aegis/runs.py, aegis/api.py or aegis/evidence.py runs in them.

E3_kv_cache_oracle.why: E1 and E3 call the model adapter directly (llm_common / aegis.model_client over TCP to a llama-server host process that llm_isolation starts itself); no code in aegis/runs.py, aegis/api.py or aegis/evidence.py runs in them.

E2_pipeline_canary.why: E2 runs the broker's attack path: P4 changes what it withholds (re-encoded canaries, incomplete scans), when it writes (before the reply) and adds detector and quota entries to the audit log. The claim is re-measured on the P4 code.

E4_injection_output_isolation.why: E4 runs the broker's attack path and replays model text against the API gate: P4 changes the withholding rules, the audit log contents and the API's token handling (capability tokens). Re-measured on the P4 code.

E5_failure_handling.why: E5 runs broker runs against a failing or killed backend and calls the API: P4 restructures Broker.attack and generate() (cut-off handling, writes before the reply) and changes the API. Re-measured on the P4 code.

changes.reason: finale P4: optional per-call timeout_s (deadline mode, task 1); UNIX-socket owner must equal the expected mapped UID, AEGIS_MODEL_UNIX_SOCKET_OWNER_UID (task 2, F4).

E1_canary_matrix.why: E1 and E3 call the adapter directly over TCP. The P4 change adds an optional timeout_s argument to generate()/_request() (default None keeps the configured timeout: the request body, the cache guard, the watchdog and the error mapping are unchanged), and an expected-owner check for the UNIX-socket transport (AEGIS_MODEL_UNIX_SOCKET_OWNER_UID), inactive over TCP; describe() returns the same keys when the new variable is unset (tests/test_finale_p3_model_client.py, tests/test_finale_p4_userns.py P4U05-P4U07).
